intro: CAVA Balsamic Date Vinaigrette brings a perfect balance of sweet and tangy flavors to your Mediterranean bowl or pita. This signature dressing combines aged balsamic vinegar with smooth date puree, creating a naturally sweet finish. At just 60 calories, it enhances any meal from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) without overwhelming your customization. Explore how this dressing complements the [full CAVA menu](/).
priceCalories: Balsamic Date Vinaigrette is included with your order at no extra charge, with up to 2 dressings per bowl or pita. At only 60 calories per serving, it provides a lighter dressing option compared to cream-based alternatives. With 7g of carbs and 4g of fat, it adds flavor while keeping your meal balanced and nutritious.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this vinaigrette apart is the natural sweetness from date puree, which eliminates the need for refined sugars. The aged balsamic vinegar provides depth and complexity, while dates add a subtle caramel-like sweetness. This unique combination creates a Mediterranean-inspired flavor profile that enhances vegetables, grains, and proteins without artificial ingredients or excessive calories.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Balsamic Date Vinaigrette contains 60 calories with 0g protein, 7g carbohydrates, and 4g fat. The carbohydrates come primarily from natural date sugars, providing quick energy without refined sweeteners. This macro profile makes it suitable for various dietary preferences. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to plan your complete meal with precise nutritional information.
whatsInside: The ingredient list is refreshingly simple: aged balsamic vinegar and date puree. The aged balsamic provides the signature tangy flavor with subtle complexity from the aging process. Date puree contributes natural sweetness and a smooth, velvety texture. This clean ingredient profile means no preservatives, artificial flavors, or unnecessary additives in your dressing.
tasteLike: Balsamic Date Vinaigrette delivers a harmonious blend of tangy and sweet flavors. The initial taste is bright and acidic from the balsamic vinegar, followed by a smooth, caramel-like sweetness from dates. The finish is clean without being overly sugary, allowing the natural flavors of your bowl ingredients to shine through while adding depth and richness.
customize: Pair this vinaigrette with options from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) like SuperGreens or grains for optimal flavor. It works beautifully drizzled over roasted vegetables, grilled proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains), and fresh toppings. Mix with other dressings like Lemon Herb Tahini for a unique flavor combination, or use it to balance spicier elements.
pairsWell: Balsamic Date Vinaigrette pairs exceptionally well with roasted vegetables, particularly Brussels sprouts, sweet potatoes, and cauliflower. It complements grilled chicken, falafel, and lamb meatballs perfectly. The sweet-tangy profile balances salty feta cheese and briny olives. Try it with selections from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) for tested flavor combinations.
healthyChoice: At 60 calories with no protein and minimal fat, this vinaigrette is a smart choice for calorie-conscious diners. The natural sweetness from dates provides energy without refined sugars or corn syrup. With only whole food ingredients, it supports clean eating goals while delivering satisfying flavor. The portion-controlled serving helps maintain balanced macros throughout your meal.
howToOrder: When building your bowl or pita at CAVA, select Balsamic Date Vinaigrette during the dressing step. You can choose up to 2 dressings at no additional cost. Request it on the side if you prefer to control the amount. The dressing is available at all [CAVA Locations](/locations) and comes standard with most orders unless you opt out.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Garlic Dressing at 180 calories and Greek Vinaigrette at 130 calories, Balsamic Date Vinaigrette offers a lighter option at 60 calories. While Hot Harissa Vinaigrette and Lemon Herb Tahini match the 60-70 calorie range, the date-sweetened profile provides unique flavor complexity. The natural sweetness distinguishes it from more acidic or spicy alternatives on the dressings menu.
whoShouldTry: This vinaigrette appeals to health-conscious diners seeking natural ingredients and lower calories. Those who enjoy sweet-savory flavor combinations will appreciate the date and balsamic pairing. It works for Mediterranean food enthusiasts and anyone building bowls with roasted vegetables or grains. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) if you have specific dietary restrictions.
worthTrying: Balsamic Date Vinaigrette is absolutely worth trying for its unique flavor profile and clean ingredients. The natural sweetness from dates creates a distinctive taste that stands out among standard vinaigrettes. At 60 calories and included with your meal, there is no downside to experimenting. It transforms simple ingredients into a cohesive, restaurant-quality Mediterranean bowl.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Balsamic Date Vinaigrette?
faqs.a: CAVA Balsamic Date Vinaigrette contains 60 calories per serving, making it one of the lighter dressing options available. It has 7g of carbohydrates and 4g of fat with 0g protein.

faqs.q: Is Balsamic Date Vinaigrette included with my CAVA order?
faqs.a: Yes, Balsamic Date Vinaigrette is included at no extra charge with your bowl or pita. You can select up to 2 dressings per order without additional cost.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Balsamic Date Vinaigrette?
faqs.a: The vinaigrette contains just two main ingredients: aged balsamic vinegar and date puree. This simple combination creates natural sweetness without refined sugars or artificial additives.

faqs.q: Is Balsamic Date Vinaigrette vegan and gluten-free?
faqs.a: Yes, Balsamic Date Vinaigrette is both vegan and gluten-free, made entirely from plant-based ingredients. Visit the CAVA Gluten Free Menu and allergen information for complete dietary details.

faqs.q: What does CAVA Balsamic Date Vinaigrette taste like?
faqs.a: It offers a balanced sweet and tangy flavor profile. The aged balsamic provides acidity and depth, while date puree adds natural caramel-like sweetness without being overly sugary or heavy.
